thread:
Priya (PM): Quick heads-up — kicking off the co-sell POC with ApexCloud. Need a short tech handoff thread so we can align on: SSO, network connectivity, pricing SKU mapping, telemetry contract, and timeline. Target start Mon 2026-03-30. Who can own which pieces?
Anita (SE): I can own infra + runtime config. Clarifying Q: ApexCloud requested peering but enterprise org policy may block peering. Do we have a PrivateLink option?
ApexCloud - DevEng: We prefer PrivateLink (no cross-org peering). We can provide an endpoint service. We'll need subnets + allowed CIDR for the interface endpoints.
Marcus (Security): PrivateLink sounds good. We'll need to exchange cert bundle and a short risk note. Also please flag if the POC will process any PII — that'll bump the questionnaire. I'll fill the security questionnaire once we have the network approach.
Jon (Pricing): For co-sell SKUs, recommendation is Reserved-25 + overage at committed rate OR temporary trial SKU for POC. Need expected QPS and avg tokens per request to price. Can someone share a small sample traffic profile?
Anita (SE): Sample traffic below — this is what ApexCloud said they'd run for week 1.

```
# curl example
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-2-large", "inputs":"summarize this...", "max_tokens":256}'
```
Anita (SE): And minimal Terraform fragment for PrivateLink route table attachment: 
```
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "redwood_private" {
  vpc_id            = "vpc-0abc..."
  service_name      = "com.amazonaws.vpce.apexcloud-redwood"
  subnet_ids        = ["subnet-aaa","subnet-bbb"]
}
```
Priya (PM): Thanks — @Jon, tentative traffic: 200 RPS peak, avg 40 tokens/request, bursts up to 500 RPS during demos. That should let you model costs.
Jon (Pricing): Got it, that maps to ~2.4M tokens/day peak. I'll prepare a POC SKU and a draft quote by EOD tomorrow.
Marcus (Security): Two quick asks: 1) we need a signed DPA before production-ish data. 2) If ApexCloud will ingest logs, we need a telemetry/dataflow diagram. Can ApexCloud share the minimal logs they need?
ApexCloud - DevEng: For now, just anonymized request/response latencies + error counts. No raw payloads. We'll send a telemetry spec by tomorrow.
PartnerOpsBot: Created ticket POC-1342 (ops) and assigned to Anita, Marcus, Jon, Priya. Link: https://tickets.redwood.ai/POC-1342 :white_check_mark:
Anita (SE): I'll start a runbook draft in Confluence and drop the link here once done. Expect an infra checklist (PrivateLink endpoints, SG rules, cert exchange).
Priya (PM): Awesome. Action items: Anita infra/runbook, Marcus sec questionnaire + DPA, Jon quote, ApexCloud telemetry spec. Meeting to sync Mon 3/30 09:30 PT — send calendar invite. :thumbsup:
ApexCloud - DevEng: Thanks everyone — we'll share endpoint service details and a contact (devops@apexcloud.io) in the ticket.
Priya (PM): closing loop — please update POC-1342 comments instead of new threads so everything stays in one place.
Anita (SE): Will do.
Jon (Pricing): I'll post the draft quote in the ticket when ready.
Marcus (Security): I'll upload the questionnaire answers and the DPA checklist to the ticket by EOD tomorrow.
Priya (PM): Perfect — thanks team.
